posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
(Edit: The First Sentinels Craft Swap is now happening! Check it out!)

 

Okay, so over on this thread, I was inspired for the idea for this thread:

We've got a bunch of people here on the forums who like making stuff and we do all love Sentinels, right? Right! 

Also, who doesn't love getting stuff? No one, that's who!

So here is the proposal: We do a Sentinels craft swap. I'd even volunteer to do the organisationals. 

Crafty forumites get partnered up and make each other a Sentinels themed thing. Then they send that thing to their partner, and once they've got it, they put a picture of it on here and we all get to admire that thing (and be crazy jealous, because that always happens). 

Anything is a thing: scarf, pencilcase, doll, ornament, notebook, somthing useful for the game, jewlery, cookies (okay, that might be a mess), a funny hat, a fancy token box, a t-shirt, fridge magnets, artwork, woodwork, metalwork, yarnwork, fimowork, 'turning-one-thing-into-another-thing' work... 

What I want to know now is:

Who might want to join this swap?

 

(Also: Can we get official approval for this swap lest I get keelhauled for running some sort of IP piracy racket?)

But if we all agreed to have a swap in, say, June, sorted out swap partners at the beginning of June and then set out our things at the end of June, that would give us all sufficent time to make room in our busy schedules for it, I think.

Just an idea though, I am totally open for discussion on this. If people wanted to do it now, I'd still be up for organising, I just would have to drop out of the participation side of things.

posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
Well, we could each list up what we can do, craft wise, put down some info on what we'd like to have or who our favourite heroes/villains are and then try to do the pairings so they fit best.

Or we make a totally random draw of it, and then the partners figure out afterwards what they can feasibly make for each other. Which has some drawbacks, and some advantages.

Or, third option, everybody goes ahead and just makes one thing they wanna make (according to some pre-set dimensions) and then we do a circular sending thing. So you would not be getting something from the person you made something for.

What would people prefer?

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
My Perler creations are on the Fan Art topic.  I've assembled a fine collection of Nemesis symbols (but don't ask me to do Sky-Scraper's...her unfinished design mocks me...accursed perlers merely having three types of grey...) and a few arts inspired by game sprites.  I imagine I could come up with something for someone else (I've been trying to figure out how to do some modifications to some DynoWarz:  The Destruction of Spondylus sprites for Unity and Mr. Chomps...).  The Nemesis symbols are easy, and I can modify anything people find lacking (should've gone with grey rather than that obnoxious clear green for the Argent Adept background...).

I'm in.  Whoever gets me will just have to look over my wares and see what they would like and how hard they want me to work!
